comparison.objective: Calibrate and lock a gripper opening limit versus orient and insert a battery, then thread a flashlight tail cap.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve rotation while another object is stabilized, but the candidate requires simultaneous driver counterholding against a jam nut; the flashlight requires close-fit insertion and cap thread engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate scores preserved 90° adjustment and repeated-cycle drift; the flashlight scores correct battery polarity and a cap seated after at least 300° of threading.
comparison.reason: Generic bimanual screwing overlaps, but coupled adjustment preservation and post-lock functional cycling test a meaningfully different ability.
